user.title: Connect to StudyLife
user.description: Base URL of your self-hosted StudyLife server, e.g. {example}. The server protects its API with personal API keys — generate one on the StudyLife app's Setup page ("Home Assistant" card) and paste it here.

data_description.api_key: One-time pairing step: generate a key on the StudyLife app's Setup page ("Home Assistant" card) and copy the value it shows. The key is long-lived — it never rotates and never expires; it only becomes invalid if you regenerate or revoke it in the app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair StudyLife
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key is no longer accepted by the server — it was regenerated or revoked in the StudyLife app (it never expires on its own). Generate a key on the app's Setup page ("Home Assistant" card) and paste the new value here.

data_description.api_key: Generate a new key on the StudyLife app's Setup page ("Home Assistant" card) and copy the value it shows.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Reconfigure StudyLife
reconfigure_confirm.description: Update the URL and/or API key for this connection — e.g. if the server's address changed or there was a typo during initial setup.

data_description.api_key: If only the server address changed, the existing key usually still works. If you do need a new one: generate it on the StudyLife app's Setup page ("Home Assistant" card) and copy the value it shows.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL and make sure the server is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Generate a new key on the StudyLife app's Setup page and use that value.

abort.already_configured: This StudyLife server is already configured.

course_color.name: Course color (deprecated)

update_session.name: Update session
update_session.description: Changes individual fields of an existing session (only the fields given are changed, the rest is kept).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Only needed if multiple StudyLife servers are configured.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: ID of the session to edit.

course_id.name: Course ID
course_id.description: Numeric ID of the course. Must exist in your course catalog (built-in or custom) if changing the session's course.

course_name.name: Course name (deprecated)
course_name.description: Deprecated, ignored. The server now derives the course name from the catalog.

course_color.name: Course color (deprecated)
course_color.description: Deprecated, ignored. The server now derives the course color from the catalog.

start_time.name: Start
start_time.description: New start of the study session.

end_time.name: End
end_time.description: New end of the study session.

is_completed.name: Completed
is_completed.description: Mark the session as completed or not.

delete_session.name: Delete session
delete_session.description: Deletes a study session by its session ID.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Only needed if multiple StudyLife servers are configured.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: ID of the session to delete (see sensor attributes or the calendar).

set_course_goal.name: Set course goal
set_course_goal.description: Creates or updates the target date, grade and/or completion note for a course.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Only needed if multiple StudyLife servers are configured.

course_id.name: Course ID
course_id.description: Numeric ID of the course. Must exist in your course catalog (built-in or custom).

course_name.name: Course name (deprecated)
course_name.description: Deprecated, ignored. The server now derives the course name from the catalog.

completion_note.name: Completion note
completion_note.description: Freeform note about finishing the course.

generate_exam_plan.name: Generate exam plan
generate_exam_plan.description: Spreads a course's still-open topics across free calendar slots up to the exam date and creates the study sessions.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Only needed if multiple StudyLife servers are configured.

exam_date.name: Exam date
exam_date.description: Date of the exam. Sessions are scheduled up to the day before.

session_length_minutes.name: Session length (minutes)
session_length_minutes.description: Length of each proposed session. Default: 90.

total_hours.name: Total study hours
total_hours.description: Total planned study time before the exam. Default: estimated automatically from open topics.

set_active_program.name: Switch active study programme
set_active_program.description: Sets which study programme the StudyLife app itself treats as active (course selection, web dashboard). All programmes stay visible in Home Assistant as their own devices with their own sensors regardless - only the hub's course-related entities (course picker, goals calendar, resolved course lists) follow the switch.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Only needed if multiple StudyLife servers are configured.

program_id.name: Programme ID
program_id.description: ID of the study programme (see sensor.studylife_active_program, attribute 'programs'). Omit to switch back to the built-in programme.

device_not_studylife.message: This device does not belong to any StudyLife integration.

multiple_servers_need_device_id.message: Multiple StudyLife servers configured - please specify device_id in the service call.

course_not_in_catalog.message: Course ID {course_id} does not exist. It must be a course from your StudyLife catalog (built-in or custom, see /api/courses) - the server no longer accepts an unknown course_id with a manually supplied course_name.

course_rejected_by_server.message: StudyLife rejected course ID {course_id} - the course list may have changed. This integration refreshes its course catalog on the next poll (or reload the integration now to refresh it immediately), then try again.

unknown_program.message: Programme ID {program_id} is not known (sensor.studylife_active_program, attribute 'programs').
